entries.subject: walina xaq
entries.object: leh yel haday Kuwaasha magal gelyo siyaasadeed Asago ha bisdhaasha cadaadis

spans.text: Nam kasta walina xaq yes leh yel haday Kuwaasha magal gelyo siyaasadeed Asago ha bisdhaasha cadaadis.
Qoysku waa unnuga saldhiga u ah Bulsho , welina xaq yes Leh in dowladhis iyo mujtamacaash bad badshaa.
Nam kasta welina xaq yes Leh in si xor eg yes dhaqmo diintiis.

Mid waliba welina xaq yes Leh in us hela xornimo xaga ra,yiga iyo kodaas ;welinag xaq haday yes Leh in us Yedba ha farhayaan hakarnag ra,yigiisa iyo in uu kowta ,hela ,dhuwta warar iyo fikirdhaa oso oo isticmaalaasha qalab kasta warbaahin ah oso Yedba yes hadhokonag ama yedba xayiraal hakar nag wax sohandhaa.
Mid weli welina xaq yes Leh in us helo xornimo oo ha qayb gele asa -shiyaal iyo urur leh ulajeeda Nawya-gela Leh.
Nam kasta gaam xaq yes leh in haqiib gala maamul yalka si toos ek Ama ese oo si xor eke yes doraniyera lam ha wakiil eg.

Nam kasta gaam xaq yes leh in shaqo hela ,in yes mida biinaada dorasha shaqad et isa qowaash , in shuruudh dhaa shaqa yaata harme cadaalad il hoosan, isana yes daneysiniya iyo in shaqa la,aata ha dug ened.
Nam kasta , yedee Lisa ha bisneda ,gaam xaq yes leh in hela mishaar il me aka yed Lam xaqadey Asa shaqa mee qowaasha.
Namag shaqeyshaasha gaam xaq yes leh in isa hala mishaar weli yastarniyar,waana ha felna si asa hanuulaada isi iyo hiraas .waana in wali hakaba hon yes baahada daryeel haqadee.

spans.text: Nam kasta walina xaq yes leh yel haday Kuwaasha magal gelyo siyaasadeed Asago ha bisdhaasha cadaadis.

Nam kasta welina xaq yes Leh in si xor eg yes dhaqmo diintiis.

Nam kasta , yedee Lisa ha bisneda ,gaam xaq yes leh in hela mishaar il me aka yed Lam xaqadey Asa shaqa mee qowaasha.
